name: FNB - Sistem Pesanan, Stok & Laporan Harian

parameters.content:
## SETUP SEKALI SAJA
1. Buka node 'Konfigurasi Pesanan' dan 'Konfigurasi Laporan', ganti: chat_id_dapur, chat_id_owner, email_owner, email_supplier, sheet_id, nama_toko
2. Buat Google Sheet dengan 2 tab:
- Tab 'Pesanan' header baris 1: order_id | waktu | pelanggan | tipe | member | item | subtotal | diskon | promo | biaya_layanan | ongkir | pajak | total_bayar | poin | status
- Tab 'Laporan Harian' header baris 1: tanggal | omzet | jumlah_pesanan | rata_rata | menu_terlaris | stok_kritis
3. Ganti GANTI_CHAT_ID_OWNER di workflow 'FNB - Penangan Error (Telegram)'
4. Aktifkan workflow (toggle Active) supaya jadwal dan stok permanen jalan
Credential Telegram, Gmail, Google Sheets sudah terpasang.

## ALUR 1: PESANAN MASUK
POST /webhook/fnb-order
Body contoh:
{"pelanggan":"Budi","email":"budi@mail.com","tipe":"delivery","alamat":"Jl. Mawar 5","member":"gold","jarak_km":3,"kode_promo":"HEMAT10","catatan":"tanpa pedas","items":[{"kode":"nasi-goreng","qty":2},{"kode":"es-teh","qty":2}]}
Tipe: dine-in (wajib 'meja') | takeaway | delivery (wajib 'alamat')
Menu: nasi-goreng, mie-goreng, ayam-bakar, es-kopi-susu, es-teh
Promo: HEMAT10 (min 50rb), GRATISONGKIR (delivery min 75rb)
Happy hour 14:00-16:00: minuman diskon 10%

## ALUR 2: LAPORAN HARIAN (22:00 WIB)
Rekap omzet, jumlah pesanan, menu terlaris, stok kritis. Dikirim ke Telegram + Email owner, dicatat di Sheets, dan draft order dikirim ke supplier jika ada bahan menipis (<=10).
